note: CFPB convention: below 580. Sources with a 'below 600' bucket map here approximately; see per-source notes when added.
CFPB convention 720 and above. Also the TCCP survey's '720 or greater' targeted-tier bucket and the Philly Fed Y-14 '>=720 Credit Score' bucket, both exact matches.
TCCP survey targeted-tier bucket: CFPB near-prime and prime combined. Issuers report one median APR for the band.
TCCP survey targeted-tier bucket: CFPB subprime and deep subprime combined. Issuers report one median APR for the band.

Philly Fed Y-14 '<660 Credit Score' bucket: CFPB near-prime, subprime and deep subprime combined. Used for purchase volume per account, median original credit limit, and the share of new accounts and commitments.
Philly Fed Y-14 '660-719 Credit Score' bucket: CFPB prime, an exact match. The TCCP band 620_719 is wider (near-prime plus prime); the two are not the same population.
Used when the source does not split by credit tier. Philly Fed balances, utilization and delinquency are published for the whole Y-14 panel only, so they carry tier all.
